run_kappa_thermal_conductivity: run thermal conductivity calculations for a list of atomic structures using KappaRunner
create_kappa_runner: create a KappaRunner with an ASE calculator and input atomic structures for kappa calculations
load_kappa_data_list: load atomic structures from an extxyz file using get_kappa103_data_list for kappa calculations
calculate_force_constants: calculate second and third order force constants for relaxed structures using KappaRunner calculate method
write_kappa_results: write kappa calculation results to a gzipped JSON file using KappaRunner write_results method
